title: Building the Future of Digital Identity
text:
# Academia & Research
Universities and research institutions working on AI, privacy, biometrics, cybersecurity, and inclusive digital systems

# Industry & Providers
Established firms and technology providers building mature ID solutions for Aadhaar ecosystem requirements.

# Why Join SITAA
Benefits to SITAA Cohorts

# Financial Support
Milestone-based grants for startups and academia to build and validate innovative solutions

# Mentorship & Guidance
Access to domain experts, technical advisors, and ecosystem leaders

# UIDAI Test Environment
Test and refine solutions using Aadhaar- aligned infrastructure and sandbox environment

# Business Network
Engage with industry leaders, research institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders

# Investor & VC Access
Curated access to venture capital firms, angel investors, and strategic partners

# Certification & Recognition
Official recognition and validation support from UIDAl for selected candidates
